subject: A free "Your Brain vs AI" lecture for Amity students
body:
Dear Head, Amity Centre for Guidance and Counselling,

I read that Amity Noida launched its Centre for Cognitive Science this year, bringing AI, neuroscience and psychology together. That meeting point is exactly what I teach, from the student's side.

Students now have AI tools that write, summarise and answer in seconds. What most programmes do not teach is how to keep their own attention, memory and judgement strong while using them. I run UnAI Labs, where I teach short, science-backed courses on AI literacy, neuroplasticity, deep focus and brain health.

I would like to offer Amity a free 45-minute guest lecture, "Your Brain vs AI", for any batch you choose, online or on campus. It is plain-language, based on published research, and leaves students with three habits they can use the same week.

Would a slot in November or December work for your calendar?

Warm regards,
Manish Kumar Singh
Founder, UnAI Labs
unai-labs.com

If you would rather not hear from me again, reply "no thanks" and I will not write again.
